prompt:
Check one candidate model relation against sentences of a long engineering document. Unit ids show the order of the sentences in the document; the sentences come from different places.

Candidate: Vessel AIS Receiver provides "a Position Quality Flag" to Fleet Dispatch Console (an information or material flow).

Evidence sentences used to propose the candidate:
S104: An onboard logger timestamps observations and retains a local history during intermittent communications.
S105: The Vessel AIS Receiver produces a Position Quality Flag when position integrity checks fail or confidence falls below its configured threshold.
S224: The Duty Planner updates work priorities when access conditions or resource availability change.
S225: The Fleet Dispatch Console uses the quality flag to support movement planning.

Other sentences of the same document that mention this item, a similarly named item, or another element that produces or sends such an item:
S159: SCADA Gateway uses the deviation notice to flag work packages that may require technical review.

Answer "supported" only if the document states that Vessel AIS Receiver produces or sends this item AND that Fleet Dispatch Console receives or uses the same item (it may be named more briefly in one sentence), and no other sentence shows that the item Fleet Dispatch Console uses comes from a different producer or is a different item with a similar name. Answer "unsupported" if the sentences describe different items, the wrong elements, the opposite direction, or if another producer of the item the consumer uses is stated. Answer "uncertain" if the text is not clear enough. Return JSON {"verdict": ..., "reason": "one sentence"}.
response: {"verdict":"supported","reason":"S105 states the Vessel AIS Receiver produces the Position Quality Flag, and S225 states the Fleet Dispatch Console uses 'the quality flag' for movement planning; no other sentence names a different producer or a similarly named item."}
